name: Content Metrics
description: shows charts of content activity (e.g. items created per month over the past year).
project_description:
Contributors, editors and other content maintainers of long-running Drupal sites should be able to easily see how their content has evolved over time.

 This module provides charts illustrating content activity, such as articles created per month over the past 12 months. Additional related charts included comments over time.

 Most of the charts have exposed filters to customise their output.

 Dependencies:

 
 ChartJS API module 
 
 Install like any standard Module. See Installing Modules .
